_note: Original tmux-handlr manifest (herdr ships none for dsh). Specific to the deepseek-harness TUI interface (@deepseek-ai/dsh --profile tui), named dsh-tui to distinguish it from other dsh interfaces (web, headless, …). dsh-tui normally self-reports state via dsh-herdr-agent-state -> agent-state.sh (an authoritative override honored above these rules); this manifest is the screen-scrape fallback for when that plugin isn't loaded. The 'dsh' alias lets a pane typed only by process-match still resolve here. No distinct needs-input signal observed yet.
